cards.bank: State Bank for Foreign Economic Affairs of Turkmenistan (Vnesheconombank)
State Bank for Foreign Economic Affairs of Turkmenistan (Vnesheconombank)

note: The State Bank for Foreign Economic Affairs of Turkmenistan's standard tariffs, valid from 1 April 2026 (VAT included, note 9), linked from tfeb.gov.tm/page/56 and read in full on 2026-11-03 (the PDF's text extracts; fetched again the same day, the same bytes). Halkbank's 'credit card', read in earlier rounds, carries only a consumer loan's proceeds and isn't written. Section 6.16 gives the bank's VISA Gold and Mastercard Gold credit cards an annual credit rate of 15% (6.16.1) and an annual rate for an overdue payment of 18% (6.16.2), written as the rate after a late payment. The Gold card is priced in US dollars only (its insurance deposit 300 USD and its issue 50 USD, where the other international cards also give a figure in manat), so it's written in dollars; the tariff doesn't say in what currency its credit is lent. Its 50 dollars buy the card's issue with five years' service (6.2; a card is valid five years, note 11), written as the issue fee, with no yearly fee; the reissue at the same price after five years isn't written apart. The 300-dollar insurance deposit (страховой депозит, 6.1) is held, not charged, and the game's card holds no deposit, so it isn't written. A cash withdrawal in manat in Turkmenistan costs 1% (6.5), written as the cash fee (in foreign currency in Turkmenistan 2%, abroad 3% with a floor of 4 dollars: not written, the game's card holding one cash fee). Cashless payment abroad costs 1%, at least 0.50 dollars (6.9), written as the share on spending in another currency (its floor not written); cashless payment in Turkmenistan costs 0.5% (6.8), which the game's card has no term for and isn't written. The monthly SMS notice is free on the Gold card. The Millikart Owerdraft, the national card with an overdraft, bears 12% (5.9), costs 23 manat to issue with five years' service (5.1), and its overdraft carries the bank's 100-manat commission for arranging an individual's overdraft (9.1.3.2), both once at the start, written together as the issue fee of 123; its cashless payments cost nothing (5.4) and it prices no cash withdrawal ('-', 5.3; the game's card can't refuse cash, so none is written); its SMS service (1.15 manat a month, 5.8) is optional and isn't written. The tariff states no minimum payment, grace period, late fee, over-limit fee or limit for either card, so none is written; the bank may change its tariffs without notice (note 8).
